question: With the alpha1 reward and alpha3 aversive long-term stores (revision 11), does spaced re-teaching of a Stage 1 training board keep it correct after 10 further training boards are taught, and at which eta?
task: Predeclared test of the alpha3 pivot (journal 2026-10-26, before any r11 result); fix-goal task 1 decision rule otherwise unchanged
override: Only learner.memory.eta changes (in memory, per probe; it sets the restrained, alpha1 and alpha3 rates); everything else is the revision-11 registration.
data: Training panels of the base registration only. Validation and final rows are never loaded.
aBoardRule: As probe v6: one A board per stratum, the first training panel by panelId whose unaided scratch choice is not the certified success (flagged fallback if a stratum is all correct). The MBON14 readout term can change scratch choices, so the A boards are re-derived and may differ from v6.
lesson: As probe v6 (informative: verified task pulse plus Stockfish value pulse); PAM-alpha1 co-stimulated only with verified task-success pulses and PPL1-alpha3 only with verified task-failure pulses.
sequence: From scratch memory: lesson on A, 5 other boards, lesson on A, 5 other boards, lesson on A, 10 other boards; every other board is distinct and taught once; A is assessed after every lesson.
interferenceRule: The 23 other training panels ordered by sha256(seed:A:panelId); the first 20, in that order. The first 10 are probe v5's interfering boards in v5's order. The same boards and order are used for every eta.

decision.rule: Choose the largest eta whose A board is the unique top choice after the final 10 interfering lessons in at least 3 of 4 probes. A pass is reported as spaced-training retention, not one-shot retention. If none passes, the memory path stops and is reported to the researcher, with no further mechanism.

measures: A certified-move rank and correctness after every lesson
A correctness right after each of its own lessons and at the end of each gap
each interfering board's rank before and after its lesson
pulse channels, currents, restrained and alpha1 factors and changed-edge counts
scope: Diagnostic spaced-repetition probe on training boards with one replica; not a gate result, not a learning claim and not biological validation. Lesson counts are not biological spacing intervals.
comparison: Matched to probe v6 (same replica, A-board rule, gaps, interference rule and order, etas and lesson procedure; cue v4 unchanged). Differs only in the learner: revision 11 adds the alpha3 store and the +MBON14 readout term.
